deadline.value: Admission to Medicine PhD studies happens continuously through the year, in steps.
deadline.quote: Admission to PhD studies at the Faculty of Medicine takes place continuously during the year

toefl_min.value: Faculty of Medicine requires at least 79 on the internet-based TOEFL for PhD admission, where English proof is needed.
toefl_min.quote: at least 79 points on the Internet-based test

ielts_min.value: Faculty of Medicine requires an IELTS Academic overall score of 6.5, with no section below 5.0, where English proof is needed.
ielts_min.quote: the Academic Module must be completed with a score of at least 6.5 and no section below 5.0

english_waiver.value: Applicants with a non-Nordic degree and a native language other than English must prove English equivalent to a three-year upper secondary qualification, or take TOEFL or IELTS if no certified English results exist.
english_waiver.quote: you must also prove that you have English language skills equivalent to a three-year upper secondary school qualification | If no previous certified English results can be proven

gre_subject.value: The Faculty of Medicine page does not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: A supervisor must propose the PhD project before admission, and the project must be approved by the faculty.
supervisor.quote: before admission, a supervisor (researcher) must propose a PhD project

funding.value: Supervision and financing for the whole programme must be in place at admission. Funding type is not stated as typical or guaranteed.
funding.quote: the supervision and financing of the entire programme must be in place at the time of admission

entry_route.value: Basic eligibility is a second-cycle (master level) qualification, or 240 credits including 60 at second-cycle level.

notes: This record covers the Faculty of Medicine's PhD admission process; the subject list was not reached, so Neuroscience (Medical Science) is not saved as a separate field. The Medicine English rule is a faculty override of the university record.
